with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='composed-real-stage-',dir='/workspace/scratch/a2905ee84412') as temp:
    output=Path(temp)/'paired'
    staged=stage_datasets(root,candidate,output)
    verified=verify_staging(root,candidate,output)
    receipt=json.loads((output/MANIFEST).read_text())
    control_path=root/receipt['source']['control']['manifest']
